summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a medium risk score of 53 for the liver and a low risk score of 36 for the heart [M]. Due to liver harm, Ximelagatran was pulled from the market worldwide, starting in 2006 [3]. It was also taken off the market and removed from research testing in February 2006 to protect patient safety [5][6].
